display_long_description:
Level up your receiving, framing and blocking.

Pro Catcher VR Trainer puts you in your crouch behind home plate with a pitcher working to you at game distance, a batter in the box, an umpire behind you and a runner on first. Every pitch is called, and the moment it's over you get a technique breakdown: what you did right, what cost you the strike, and what to fix next.

• Frame borderline pitches well and the umpire gives you the strike.
• Block balls in the dirt: let one get by and the runner moves up. A run costs you 20 points.
• Up to 10 technique checks per pitch, from the real movement of your head, mitt and hand.
• Instant replay from four angles with slow motion.
• Pro Ghost: a green ghost catcher replays the pitch the right way, right beside you.
• Baseball at 60 ft 6 in with 7 pitch types, fastpitch softball at 43 ft with 6. Fastballs from 45 to 95 mph.
• Make it yours: youth, normal or large mitt in brown or black leather, mitt guide labels, two stadiums, music and voice calls.
• Catch your way: squeeze the trigger, let the pocket hold it, or go Full auto.
• Set difficulty, dirt-ball share, pitch types and pitcher and batter handedness.

For baseball and fastpitch softball catchers from youth to college, and their coaches.

Requires Meta Quest 2 or newer with Touch controllers. Play standing in a cleared space; you'll crouch, shift and drop to your knees, so a soft mat or knee pads help. No artificial locomotion.
